---
name: New problem
about: Propose a precisely stated open problem from a book or paper
title: 'New problem: '
---

### Statement

Define the objects, assumptions, quantifiers, and exact question.

### Primary source

Authors, title, year, DOI or stable link, and page/section/problem number.
Identify any editorial reformulation.

### Current status

Search date, later results checked, known special cases, and why the full
question remains unresolved. Mention any competing proof claims.

### Scope and overlap

Explain the NLA connection and list related catalog IDs or issues.

### Suggested ratings

Difficulty: hard / challenging / extreme.
Importance: interesting to specialist / interesting to the community /
broadly interesting. Briefly explain both choices.
